challenge: Fragmented supply chain operations across 50+ hospitals led to critical stockouts and uncontrolled procurement costs.
solution: Implemented Oracle Cloud SCM with AI-driven demand forecasting and automated replenishment workflows.
outcome: Achieved real-time inventory visibility and standardized procurement processes globally.
businessImpact: Eliminated critical medical stockouts, drastically improving patient care reliability while reducing manual overhead.

challenge: Legacy on-premise systems caused severe data silos, resulting in a 14-day financial close process.
solution: Seamless migration to NetSuite Cloud ERP using the AECCAR™ framework to standardize global financial processes.
outcome: Unified financial reporting and automated multi-subsidiary consolidations.
businessImpact: Accelerated the financial close to just 3 days, providing executives with real-time financial insights.

challenge: 5 distinct, siloed CRM systems prevented a unified 360-degree view of high-net-worth clients.
solution: Consolidated all divisions onto Salesforce Financial Services Cloud with Einstein AI predictive scoring.
outcome: Created a single source of truth for client data with intelligent next-best-action recommendations.
businessImpact: Increased cross-sell ratios and significantly improved relationship manager productivity.
